name: llm_list_providers
description: List all available LLM providers and their models registered in z-agent-llm-gateway. Use this before calling llm_chat to discover which providers (openai, claude, deepseek, qwen, etc.) and models are currently configured and available. The response is a list of provider names. Each provider must be configured with an API key via the provider config endpoint before it can be used for chat.
